infobox.usage: Unlocks the military checkpoint tower on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Military checkpoint key (Checkpoint) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the military base checkpoint gatehouse.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - 1 needs to be found for the quest Aid Stations

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Customs
sections.text:
- Sitting next to the Dead Scav on the couch in warehouse #7.

- On a trash bag in the blue guard shack south of the red Paradigm warehouse.

- On the ground next to the staircase at the construction site south of warehouse #17.

- In the bloody tent at the campsite east of the three-story dorms building.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the military checkpoint tower on Customs.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 2x Grenade box
- 2x Wooden ammo box
- 1x Weapon locker
